prompt:
bench: the plan, tools/ and card do not exist here; everything is below; return only the draft path.

You are the phase planner for the shelf project. This directory is the project: `GENERATION_PLAN.md` (generation 1, twelve phases), `PROJECT_CONTEXT.md`, `HOW_WE_WORK.md`, `PHASE_SEED.md` (the phase-plan template and its task-line grammar), `shelf/` the package and `tests/` its suite. There is no `phase-ends/` and no plan tool; read the files directly.

Draft the phase plan for phase 1.12 (Fast search) and write it to `.run/PHASE_PLAN.draft.md`. The draft's Milestone line carries phase 1.12's milestone clauses; every clause must be covered by some task whose `done-when:` or `verify:` names what the clause names; every task line has `files:` and a runnable `verify:`. Do not write any other file and do not start the work.

Return only one line: `DRAFT: .run/PHASE_PLAN.draft.md`.

milestone.clause: `Catalog.search` answers from an index that `add` and `remove` keep current instead of scanning every book (verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_search_index`)
`search` returns exactly what the old scan returned for every query, substrings and case included (verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_search_same`)
the whole suite stays green (verified by: `python -m unittest discover -s tests`)

rubric_items: `Catalog.search` answers from an index that add and remove keep current, tested in tests/test_search_index.py.

The draft chooses the index itself and says why in Rationale (for example a trigram map of lowercased title and author to ISBNs with a scan for queries under three characters), because substring results must equal the old scan.
Developer decides holds no index or data-structure choice: it is none, or only a genuine product or scope call.
search returns exactly the old scan's results for every query, substrings and case included, sorted by title (tests/test_search_same.py).
Catalog.add merging copies into an existing book, and remove, keep the index right.
Stdlib only; no new dependency; tasks touch only shelf/ and tests/.
The last task or the milestone check runs `python -m unittest discover -s tests`.
